note

Elevation colour is absolute — a green lowland stays green at every zoom, because the scale is the world's range, not the screen's. Region jumps target a real settlement (the medoid), since a scattered region's centroid can be open ocean.

One world, one terrain function. Zoom out and the whole sphere renders coarsely; zoom in and a detail patch regenerates just the visible ground at higher resolution. Buffer size is chosen from measured cost per zoom, so a draw stays near 250 ms at every scale.
